summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Landing Page navbar dropdowns and Accountants page theme selector. All 11 features tested and working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page navbar and Accountants page theme selector fully tested and working. Theme is stored in localStorage under key 'accountants-theme'. Available themes: light (default), dark, contrast, system.

tests.feature: Landing page navbar shows 'Para empresas', 'Contadores', 'Precios', 'Contacto' options
tests.notes: All 4 nav options visible with dark background

tests.feature: Para Empresas dropdown opens and shows 8 features with icons
tests.notes: Dropdown shows 8 features: Gestión de Empleados, Nómina Automatizada, Control de Asistencia, Vacaciones y Permisos, Evaluaciones, Reportes Avanzados, Búsqueda con IA, Portal de Empleados

tests.feature: Contadores dropdown opens and shows partner program features
tests.notes: Dropdown shows 6 features: Solo $10/mes, 30% Comisión, Multi-Cliente, Dashboard de Ganancias, Nómina RD, Reportes DGII

tests.feature: Para Empresas dropdown has CTA 'Comenzar Prueba Gratis'
tests.notes: CTA button present at bottom of dropdown linking to /register
All dropdown items and 'Ver Programa de Partners' button link to /accountants-software

tests.feature: Accountants page /accountants-software loads in LIGHT mode by default
tests.notes: Page loads with light gradient background (from-slate-50 via-white to-emerald-50)

tests.feature: Theme toggle button shows 'Apariencia' in header
Theme dropdown shows options: Claro, Oscuro, Alto Contraste, Sistema
tests.notes: All 4 theme options present in dropdown menu

tests.feature: Changing theme to 'Oscuro' changes page to dark mode
tests.notes: Dark mode applies gradient (from-slate-900 via-slate-800 to-emerald-900)

tests.feature: Theme preference is saved to localStorage
tests.notes: Theme saved under key 'accountants-theme', persists after page reload

tests.feature: Mobile menu shows expandable sections for Para Empresas and Para Contadores
tests.notes: Both sections expand to show 4 sub-items each with icons. Para Contadores items link to /accountants-software
High contrast mode shows yellow text on black background for accessibility
